main_text.p: tis, pietatis & iustitiæ: quò exercita-tiores aduersus illius insidias atque technas redderentur electorum sen-sus,ne mox,simulac præclarū aliquod è sacrosancta scriptura prolatum elo-gium audierint, assentiantur, quasi is qui tale quippiam iactat, omnino ve-rum asserat, nec ipse errare, nec alios seducere queat. Nam si cacodæmon, qua est impudentia, non est veritus, dominum, magistrum, & caput no-strum, verbis è scriptura depromptis aggredi: quid mirum, si membra corporis Christi simili ratione aggredia-tur,vt tentando circumueniat? Christus sanè præsentiens has diabolicas fraudes, repudiauit prorsus testimo-nium, quamlibet verum, sibi à Sata-na datum. Paulus item ægrè ferens spiritum Pythonis è puella diuinatri-ce, clamantem quòd Apostoli serui Dei excelsissimi essent, viam salutis annuntiantes,compescuit: non vt sal-si argueret, aut in suspicionem addu-ceret salutis annunciationem ore A-[?]c. ii

page.notes: The line-end "A-" after "ore" carries a small mark that may be a hyphen or the start of an abbreviated reference; read as printed. The reference "c. ii" below the text is a bare marginal reference and is given as a note. Faint show-through text in the left margin and at the lower left is not transcribed.
